options.product: Auth0 - OIDC applications and Enterprise Connections
options.configuration: Documentation research only; connection-scoped inbound SCIM

conditions: Confirm the exact tier, region, application and OIDC discovery configuration.
An upstream enterprise OIDC connection and a downstream application OIDC client are distinct integrations.

evidence.summary: Auth0 documents OIDC authentication and application configuration through OIDC discovery. No tenant or application was tested.

conditions: The plan or agreement must include Enterprise Connections; the selected entitlement has not been verified.
Enable inbound SCIM on a supported enterprise connection and verify connection-specific tokens and attribute mappings.
Provisioning in Auth0 does not by itself update the SaaS application's local records or revoke its local sessions.

evidence.summary: Auth0 documents connection-scoped inbound SCIM user creation, updates, deactivation and deletion, with an Enterprise Connections entitlement prerequisite.

conditions: SCIM groups support user members, not arbitrary nested-group semantics.
Verify entitlement, group limits, organization membership and downstream application synchronization before assigning availability.

evidence.summary: The inbound SCIM guide describes group lifecycle operations and user-only group members; external-system synchronization is a separate integration using events.
